title: Absorption decisions stand on what was observed, and survive a cold restart
description:
Absorbed from gvc final-review findings 88ea36a8 (high), c244ce2c, d6356432 and 95f5ee1a (2026-09-26). These bear on gvc's own done, items A3, A5 and A7:
- combineGating reads a runnable acceptance item that has NO evidence as 'demonstrated' when the oracle observed nothing. An absence of observation is not an observation (A3: running the item is the authoritative verdict).
- The reporter's done_item and demonstrating_check (nfo) are promised in the prompt but not fed into the absorption decision. Wire them in as inputs (never as the verdict), or stop promising them.
- A recorded absorption must be finished before the target, evidence-table and acceptance gates in decideFinding, so a restart mid-absorption does not re-decide it differently (A5).
- The absorption depth bound (qjj) must be recorded on the run branch, so a cold restart applies the same bound (A7).
acceptance_criteria: A runnable item with no evidence reads as unobserved, never demonstrated; done_item/demonstrating_check reach the decision as inputs; a recorded absorption completes before the gates are re-evaluated; the depth bound is on the run branch and a cold restart honours it; tests cover each; go gate passes
